nameEn: Retail sale of food in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of food products in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of fruit and vegetables
retail sale of meat and meat products
retail sale of fish, crustaceans and molluscs
retail sale of bread, cakes, flour confectionery and sugar confectionery
retail sale of dairy products and eggs
retail sale of natural and organic food: health food stores
excludes: retail sale of beverages in specialised stores, see 4722
retail sale of tobacco products in specialised stores, see 4723
